text:
pagerbot: INCIDENT: p99 latency >6s for hosted-inference-eu (errors rising). Paging oncall.

julia_oncall: got the page, looking. can someone attach recent deploy?

mike_g: rolling deploy to eu-hosted at 2026-03-17T09:12Z, pushed quantized v2-small as canary.

anna.li: seeing KV cache miss rate spike to 85% around 09:14Z, many cold-gets.

julia_oncall: confirmed customer reports for slow responses. kicking runbook — will triage with runtime.

thomas_r: assigning runtime lead @mike_g and ops @luis_ops. any immediate mitigation?

luis_ops: can throttle canary traffic to 10% and scale up cache nodes. initiating now.

mike_g: applying traffic-split rollback to 0% for v2-small. command:
```
redwood traffic update hosted-inference-eu --model v2-small --weight 0
```

pagerbot: Action: rollback started by mike_g at 09:19Z.

anna.li: after rollback, p99 dropped to ~350ms within 90s. KV miss rate falling. looks like quantized variant interacts poorly with prefix caching.

julia_oncall: good catch. documenting customer impact: 12 requests timed out, several enterprise customers saw 5–8s waits. raising Sev2 containment.

sarah_pm: flagging product impact for 3 customers (enterprise tier) — will need outreach.

thomas_r: immediate checklist: 1) rollback complete 2) scale cache nodes 3) open postmortem + remediation plan.

luis_ops: cache nodes scaled x2 at 09:23Z, verifying.

mike_g: will revert quantization inference changes in staging and run regression tests. suspect K/V cache key prefixing change in runtime layer interacts with quantized weights causing cache invalidations.

julia_oncall: marking incident contained at 09:25Z. preparing handoff to oncall followup thread.

pagerbot: INCIDENT update: contained -> root cause suspected configuration mismatch between quantized runtime and KV prefixing.

--- POST-INCIDENT COORDINATION ---

julia_oncall: scheduling postmortem: proposed 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC. who owns writeup?

mike_g: I can do initial timeline and technical root cause draft.

anna.li: I'll add cache metrics and customer impact section + logs.

sarah_pm: I'll draft customer comms and coordinate with support.

thomas_r: remediation tasks (short-term + long-term):
- ACTION-1: Add staging regression job for quantized variants that validates KV cache behavior (owner: mike_g) — ETA 2026-03-22
- ACTION-2: Add feature-flag gate for prefix-change + ensure backward-compatibility (owner: mike_g) — ETA 2026-03-29
- ACTION-3: Add traffic-safeguards to deploy pipeline to block >5% traffic for new quantized builds until KV metrics pass (owner: luis_ops) — ETA 2026-03-25
- ACTION-4: Improve observability: surface prefix hit/miss per model variant in Console dashboards (owner: anna.li) — ETA 2026-03-26
- ACTION-5: Run tabletop with support & product for customer comms (owner: sarah_pm) — ETA 2026-03-20

julia_oncall: adding one more: ACTION-6: create automatic canary rollback if p99 > 2s for >2min (owner: eng-platform-team, contact: thomas_r) — ETA 2026-04-02

mike_g: note: quick mitigation patch option is to disable the new prefix optimization for quantized codepaths until tests green. will prototype in a branch today.

luis_ops: I'll add a short runbook step to scale cache nodes when miss rate >60% as interim.

anna.li: I'll collect sample traces and attach to postmortem doc. linking logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/hosted-inference-eu/4958764321

sarah_pm: customer outreach plan: proactive email + post-incident summary + offer support call. I'll own the outreach and tracker.

julia_oncall: thanks all. I'll create the postmortem doc and invite: mike_g, anna.li, luis_ops, sarah_pm, thomas_r. postmortem link (draft): https://docs.redwood.internal/postmortems/4958764321-realtime-mitig-followup

mike_g: quick note for root-cause analysis: collect sampling of KV keys that missed and compare serialization between canonical runtime and quantized runtime.

thomas_r: scheduling weekly remediation sync until all ACTION items are closed. first check-in 2026-03-24 14:00 UTC.

julia_oncall: last ask: anyone who performed commands paste them here for audit. I'll attach to incident log.

luis_ops: scaled cache nodes command: `infra cache scale --cluster eu-cache --replicas 6`

mike_g: traffic rollback command above + revert PR id: #5821

pagerbot: Incident closed -> followup tasks created. Please update the postmortem doc with progress. :white_check_mark:

anna.li: adding final note — we saw correlated small increase in batching queue latency while cache warmed; we should correlate batch sizing heuristics with cache TTLs in the long-term work.

sarah_pm: thanks team, will coordinate comms after we have the postmortem draft. :heart:

julia_oncall: closing thread here, will move action items into remediation board. ping me for clarifications.
